person:adam-dan-buettner.description_en: legal councillor (Proceßrath); established a works with partners in 1801 (p. 784)

person:bartsch.description_en: chamber commission councillor (Kammercommissionsrath), b. 1750 Leipzig, d. 1828 Gera; benefactor of the Gymnasium

person:em-fr-w-v-wietsch.description_en: owner of a manor in 1752; councillor of the Gotha provincial chamber (Landkammerrat)

person:engelhardt.description_en: privy government councillor (1853); audit councillor (Rechnungsrat, 1864): calculations of the country’s area

person:rudolf-ferber.description_en: commercial councillor (Kommerzienrat) of ancient noble descent; collection (p. 301)

person:theod-schmidt.description_en: commercial councillor (Kommerzienrat) at Altenburg; manor owner (pp. 223, 562)

person:v-taubenheim.description_en: head forester; son-in-law of the commercial councillor (Kommerzienrat) Ebeling; Ebeling foundation of 1833

person:i-nic-thomae.description_de: ilmer Bürger, gebürtig aus Eliasbrunn; Verzierer der Orgel (1812)
person:i-nic-thomae.description_en: citizen of Ilm, native of Eliasbrunn; decorated the organ in 1812

person:cotta.description_en: author of a geognostic map (probably Bernhard von Cotta)
